experiments.title: Gate questions on recorded targets
experiments.what: 43 clickable targets from six recorded pages, four gate questions each, 7 labelled
experiments.result: mutatesWorld, blastRadius, reversible JEV-SAFE; spendsOrSends MARGINAL

experiments.title: Verify pairs, recorded
experiments.what: four before and after pairs with a claim
experiments.result: outcome 4/4, errorShown 4/4, blocked 3/4; below the 8-item floor

experiments.title: Login pairs, recorded
experiments.what: three sign-in outcomes, four login questions each
experiments.result: 11/12 right; loginFormGone 0.64 on the closed-flash page

experiments.title: Live login, fixture site
experiments.what: go, fill, fill, click, verify against the local fixture site
experiments.result: gate escalated (mutatesWorld 0.81), operator composed, verify 0.99 in 503 ms; replay 0 calls

experiments.title: Bench: same claim, Jev vs check
experiments.what: eight public pages, one claim each, both judges on the same settled page
experiments.result: Jev 248 ms vs 41.0 s (164×); Jev 6/6 decided right + 2 escalates; check 7/8

experiments.title: Login three ways
experiments.what: model only · Jev + policy · Jev with the gate escalate handed to check
experiments.result: 32.8 s · 5.0 s · 180 s timeout (model fallback is verify-only)

experiments.title: Real sites, no person, no model
experiments.what: Hacker News click, Wikipedia search, GitHub issue filter
experiments.result: two auto and verified; GitHub verify contradicted 0.64 and was right

experiments.title: Element pick over 80 map lines
experiments.what: one Choice over every element plus none

experiments.title: Corpus, 80 rows, 3 parallel sessions
experiments.what: 40 public pages × a true and a false claim, 88 s wall
experiments.result: 74 settled; 73/73 right, 0 wrong, 1 escalate; JEV-SAFE 98.6% vs 50%, p = 2.9e-11; Brier 0.006

experiments.title: Recording smoke
experiments.what: record start --screenshots, then record stop -o zip, per row
experiments.result: zips with actions and screenshots; found one wrong catalog label

experiments.title: Cross-check: blind screenshot judge
experiments.what: Sonnet reads one frame per page; neutral names, claim-only prompt
experiments.result: 7/8 in 2.8 s (9.2 s per agent); the miss is the Cloudflare wall

experiments.title: Cross-check: pixel operator login
experiments.what: Sonnet with screenshot, mouse click x y, one key per press
experiments.result: passed in 14.2 s self-timed, 23.1 s wall

experiments.title: Repeat: bench, day 2
experiments.what: E5 again: eight pages, Jev and vibium check on the same settled page
experiments.result: Jev 227 ms median, 8/8 verdicts identical to day 1 (6 right, 2 escalates); check 36.4 s median, 7/8 identical (the Cloudflare page went failed → inconclusive)

experiments.title: Repeat: blind screenshot judge, day 2
experiments.what: E11 again: fresh Sonnet agents, same neutral images, same claim-only prompts
experiments.result: 8/8 verdicts identical to the day-1 blind run; 2.0 s median self-timed, 8.2 s agent wall

experiments.title: Repeat: corpus with recordings, day 2
experiments.what: E9 again with record start --screenshots per row, three parallel sessions, 143 s wall
experiments.result: 80 settled (day 1: 74); 74/74 shared verdicts identical; 77/77 decided right, 3 escalates; Jev 156 ms median; 80 recording zips
